parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat, hinged cover made of plastic that closes over the toilet seat.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl for hygiene and aesthetic purposes when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured ring-shaped seat made of plastic, attached to the bowl via hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable sitting surface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or lowered around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic cover placed on top of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and provides a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and plumbing.
